test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, IL, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some cats are pets.

2. All pets are snakes.

3. Some snakes are cats.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some snakes are pets.

Il. All cats are snakes.

III. All pets are cats.

IV. No snake is a cat.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and IV follow
